name: Wayfarer Dashboard Design System
purpose: Comprehensive styling and implementation guide for AI agents building new features in the Vite React travel dashboard app.

source_of_truth.usage: When adding new UI, follow this file before inventing new visual patterns. Reuse existing primitives, spacing, colors, density, and card structures.

high_level_design_guidelines.creative_direction: A bright, compact, soft modular travel planning workspace. The interface should feel polished, calm, tactile, and operational, with rounded white cards floating over a warm light-gray canvas.
visual_principles: Use cards as the core building block for almost every feature.
Keep the UI compact and information-dense while preserving generous rounded corners and soft spacing.
Use indigo and violet for primary actions, active states, and brand accents.
Use semantic pastels for statuses: emerald for confirmed/active, amber for pending/warning, pink for overage/error, blue for open/informational.
Use subtle borders and low-opacity shadows instead of heavy outlines.
Keep typography small and crisp: most UI text should be 10px to 14px.
Use icon tiles, avatars, status chips, progress bars, and compact rows to make dense data scannable.
Interactions should be gentle: light hover fills, soft shadow lift, opacity reveal, and simple transitions.
avoid: Do not introduce dark mode panels, saturated full-page backgrounds, or heavy black shadows.
Do not use sharp corners. Interactive controls should be rounded at least 8px, usually 12px.
Do not use oversized marketing-style typography in the dashboard.
Do not add unrelated primary color systems. Indigo remains the main action color.
Do not display dense travel data as raw tables unless a card/list pattern would not work.

base.body: font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;

glass.usage: Use for translucent floating panels or persistent command/input surfaces. The current dashboard mostly uses solid white cards, so use glass sparingly.

scrollbar-thin.usage: Apply to scrollable dashboard content areas.

rules: Use shadow-card on white cards.
Use shadow-brand only on active indigo navigation or brand icon.
Use hover shadows sparingly on rows/cards that are clickable.
Do not use default Tailwind shadow-lg unless matching an intentional floating layer.

hover_patterns: hover:bg-indigo-50 for indigo outlined icon actions
motion.reveal_pattern: Use opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 for secondary row actions.

grid_patterns.primary_content_row: grid grid-cols-3 gap-4; main panel spans col-span-2
grid_patterns.secondary_content_row: grid grid-cols-4 gap-4; large panels can span col-span-2

responsive_guidance: The current implementation is desktop-first. When adding responsiveness, collapse 4-column grids to 2 columns on tablet and 1 column on mobile.
Keep cards and rows visually identical across breakpoints; only change grid columns and stacking.
Sidebar may become a top nav or drawer on mobile, but preserve the active indigo nav item style.

Icon.purpose: Small inline SVG helper for filled utility icons.
Icon.usage: Keep icons simple, monochrome, and inherited from the surrounding text color. Use 11px to 16px icons in dense UI, 20px+ only for empty states or feature tiles.

rules: Use Card for stat blocks, lists, timelines, budget modules, quick actions, traveler lists, and activity feeds.
Nested content rows inside cards should usually use rounded-xl, subtle borders, and bg-stone-50/60.
Do not make cards pure transparent unless intentionally using the .glass utility.

SectionHeader.purpose: Compact uppercase card header with optional text action.
SectionHeader.action_class: text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-0.5
SectionHeader.usage: Use in every card section. Actions should be short phrases such as View all, Manage, See all, or Full itinerary.

Chip.base_class: inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold
rules: Use chips for statuses, never for primary actions.
Chip labels should be one or two words.
Pastel background must pair with darker semantic text.

Avatar.base_class: rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-bold text-white flex-shrink-0 ring-2 ring-white
rules: Use two-letter initials generated from names.
Use ring-2 ring-white when avatars overlap.
Keep avatars compact; dashboard avatars should be 24px to 28px.

ProgressBar.purpose: Thin progress meter for budgets, capacity, readiness, or completion.
rules: Calculate percentage as Math.min(100, Math.round(value / max * 100)).
Use pink for over-budget or error thresholds.
Pair progress bars with a tiny numeric label when space allows.

Sidebar.purpose: Persistent left navigation and account area.
Sidebar.container_class: w-52 shrink-0 flex flex-col h-full bg-white border-r border-black/[0.05] py-5 px-3 gap-1
Sidebar.brand_icon_class: w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-violet-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-brand
Sidebar.nav_item_base: flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors text-left w-full
rules: Active navigation must be solid indigo with white text and brand shadow.
Inactive navigation remains quiet gray and only gains a stone hover fill.
Keep sidebar width fixed at w-52 for desktop.

TopBar.purpose: Header for greeting, date/context, notifications, and main action.
TopBar.container_class: h-14 flex items-center justify-between px-6 bg-white border-b border-black/[0.05] shrink-0
TopBar.icon_button_class: relative w-8 h-8 rounded-xl border border-black/[0.07] bg-stone-50 flex items-center justify-center text-stone-400 hover:bg-stone-100 transition-colors
TopBar.notification_dot_class: absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-pink-500
TopBar.new_trip_button_class: flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100 transition-colors

StatCards.purpose: Four compact KPI cards at the top of the dashboard.
StatCards.card_class: rounded-2xl border border-black/[0.05] bg-white shadow-card p-4
StatCards.icon_tile_class: w-7 h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center

TripRow.purpose: Nested card row for upcoming trip summaries.
TripRow.container_class: flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl border border-black/[0.04] bg-stone-50/60 hover:bg-white hover:shadow-card transition-all group
TripRow.icon_tile_class: w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-indigo-100 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0
TripRow.row_action_class: opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 w-7 h-7 rounded-lg border border-indigo-200 bg-white flex items-center justify-center text-indigo-500 hover:bg-indigo-50 transition-all
rules: Use a nested soft row surface inside a white Card.
Show destination, status chip, dates, traveler count, progress, avatars, and a reveal action.
Keep row action hidden until hover to reduce visual noise.

Timeline.purpose: Vertical itinerary timeline with semantic dots and tiny metadata.
Timeline.dot_base_class: w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border-2
rules: Use 24px circular dots with 11px icons.
Connect all items except the last with a 1px stone line.
Keep item labels short and metadata compact.

BudgetCard.summary_class: rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-100 px-3 py-2.5 mb-3 flex items-center justify-between
rules: Use an indigo-tinted summary pill at top.
Each line item gets a colored legend dot, value, total, and progress bar.
If spent exceeds total, use pink progress and an Over label.

QuickActions.purpose: Two-by-two grid of compact tinted action buttons.
QuickActions.button_base_class: flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-medium hover:brightness-95 transition-all text-left
QuickActions.icon_tile_base_class: w-6 h-6 rounded-lg border flex items-center justify-center shrink-0
rules: Use short action labels, preferably two words.
Use a matching tinted icon tile inside the button.
Avoid solid primary buttons inside quick action grids unless one action is clearly dominant.

TravelersCard.purpose: Compact participant list with avatars, role metadata, and status chips.
TravelersCard.row_class: flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-2 hover:bg-stone-50 transition-colors
rules: Keep participant rows borderless and separated by padding/hover fill.
Use status chips at the far right.
Use 28px avatars for list identity.

ActivityFeed.purpose: Recent activity list with avatar, actor, action, and timestamp.
ActivityFeed.row_class: flex items-start gap-2.5 py-2 border-b border-black/[0.04] last:border-0
rules: Use a bottom border between activity rows, removed from the final row.
Keep activity copy short and readable at 12px.
Use amber text for noteworthy automated alerts.

when_creating_new_components: Start with the Card primitive unless the UI is navigation, top bar, or an inline row.
Add SectionHeader for every major card.
Use existing Chip statuses before adding a new status.
Use ProgressBar for any numeric completion, capacity, budget, or readiness measure.
Use Avatar for people and avatar stacks for multiple participants.
Use Icon with currentColor instead of introducing multicolor icon sets.
Prefer grid/flex composition with gap-3 or gap-4 over custom margins.
tailwind_class_preferences: Use bg-canvas for the root background.
Use bg-white for cards and main panels.
Use border-black/[0.05] for card and shell borders.
Use rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-xl for rows/buttons, rounded-lg for small icon tiles.
Use shadow-card for cards and shadow-brand for active indigo elements.
Use text-stone-800 for primary text, text-stone-400 for muted metadata.
Use text-[10px], text-[11px], text-xs, text-sm, and text-2xl as the core type scale.
accessibility: Icon-only buttons must include aria-labels when made functional.
Do not rely on color alone for status; include status text in chips.
Ensure interactive elements are at least 28px high in dense areas and preferably 32px.
Maintain visible hover and focus states for buttons and rows.
Keep semantic text colors dark enough on pastel backgrounds.
data_display: Use cards and nested rows instead of raw tables for dashboard data.
Put the strongest value in colored bold text and supporting metadata in text-stone-400.
Align repeated values consistently across rows.
Use labels sparingly but consistently; section labels should be uppercase and tracked.

ready_to_copy_recipes.default_card: rounded-2xl border border-black/[0.05] bg-white shadow-card p-4
ready_to_copy_recipes.nested_row: flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl border border-black/[0.04] bg-stone-50/60 hover:bg-white hover:shadow-card transition-all
ready_to_copy_recipes.text_action: text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-0.5
ready_to_copy_recipes.primary_nav_item: flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-brand
ready_to_copy_recipes.inactive_nav_item: flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-stone-500 hover:bg-stone-100 hover:text-stone-800 transition-colors
ready_to_copy_recipes.soft_primary_button: flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100 transition-colors
ready_to_copy_recipes.icon_button: w-8 h-8 rounded-xl border border-black/[0.07] bg-stone-50 flex items-center justify-center text-stone-400 hover:bg-stone-100 transition-colors
ready_to_copy_recipes.status_chip_base: inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold
ready_to_copy_recipes.avatar: w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-bold text-white flex-shrink-0 ring-2 ring-white
ready_to_copy_recipes.quick_action_button: flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-medium hover:brightness-95 transition-all text-left

quality_checklist: Does the new UI sit on bg-canvas or inside an existing white card?
Does it use rounded-2xl cards and rounded-xl rows/buttons?
Are text sizes compact and consistent with the existing dashboard?
Are primary actions indigo/violet and semantic states pastel?
Are shadows limited to shadow-card, shadow-brand, or a clearly justified floating shadow?
Does every card have a concise section label or clear title?
Are rows scannable with icon/avatar, primary text, metadata, status/value, and optional action?
Are hover states subtle and consistent?
Would the new feature look native beside the existing stat cards, trip rows, timeline, budget card, quick actions, travelers, and activity feed?
